recognize_zh: 脾臟切面暗紅色，佈滿無數大小一致、約 1–2 mm 的灰白至黃白色小結節，像撒了小米一樣（miliary pattern），這是粟粒性分枝桿菌感染（miliary tuberculosis）在脾臟的肉眼表現。
features: Gross cut surface of spleen with dark red congested parenchyma
Innumerable small, uniform, discrete pale tan-white nodules (about 1-2 mm)
Diffuse, evenly distributed miliary pattern throughout the section
No large confluent mass or dominant tumor nodule
Specimen label present at left edge
describe_en: Gross photograph of the cut surface of the spleen shows dark red parenchyma diffusely studded with innumerable small, uniform, pale tan-white nodules measuring roughly 1-2 mm. No large confluent mass is identified. The miliary distribution suggests hematogenous dissemination. Findings are consistent with miliary mycobacterial infection involving the spleen, with histology and acid-fast staining or culture required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Fungal abscesses and granulomas can mimic miliary nodules grossly, and are separated by GMS/PAS stains showing yeasts or hyphae rather than acid-fast bacilli.
Sarcoid produces similar small nodules composed of non-necrotizing granulomas with negative AFB and fungal stains and appropriate clinical context.

ddx.dx: Splenic involvement by lymphoma (miliary white pulp pattern)
ddx.vs: Lymphoma such as SMZL or Hodgkin lymphoma expands the white pulp into nodules that are lymphoid on histology, without granulomas or caseation.
